notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Guardian Avatars![/b]
Finally, the demo has arrived, and we hope that all of you will enjoy this game snippet!
As development closes in on our full release (more on this later) we will be updating the demo experience, both so you'll get to try out new content, but also to open up new areas of the game. 

Our original release plan was to release the Demo last week, but due to technical difficulties we were prevented in this, we are sorry about the confusion.

notes.title: Meet us @ Gamebox Herning [25.4 - 27.4]
notes.notes:
[h1]Guardian Avatars, Gather around![/h1]
Friday the 25th to Sunday the 27th we are live at [b] Game Box Festival in Herning[/b], Denmark 🎉
Here you’ll be able to do an early playthrough of our [b]Demo[/b], that we are happy to announce will launch on 
[b]May 22nd! [/b]

This demo will take you through the first few levels of the game, and give you a sense of both gameplay and story.

[h3]Additionally[/h3] we’ve decided to release Monolith Dominion in three installment, where each will provide more value through added levels, new mechanics and more story content! 
We'll have more information on this in connection with the demo launch

So, Guardian Avatars, keep a sharp eye on the leylines, and stay tuned for more information on our upcoming release 👀
